## Exercise - Character, numerical and logical variables
```{r}
some_text <- "This is some wonderful text."
some_numbers <- 12345
some_boolean <- FALSE

some_text
some_numbers
some_boolean

class(some_text)
class(some_numbers)
class(some_boolean)
```
